name: MRI Holo Viewer
summary:
Bring MRI and CT volumes into your space and explore anatomy from any angle. Volumetric information must be of reasonable voxel sizes to avoid low FPS.

Open your own .nii or .nii.gz files from headset storage or a direct download URL. The optional reference MRI and its whole-head and brain segmentations download from GitHub and remain available offline. CT data comes from your own files or URLs.
